title.narrative: Recovering from conflict: Integrated Support Programme for the most vulnerable crisis-affected communities in South Kordofan Phase II

description.narrative: Under the United Nations Trust Fund for Human Security (UNTFHS) programme in Sudan, the project aims to continue providing support to conflict-affected communities in South Kordofan using a holistic multi-sectoral and multi-agency approach to address the most acute humanitarian and human security needs in the localities and build upon the progress made through the current trust fund project in an effort to reach more vulnerable beneficiaries and increase the coverage and impact of the interventions already provided in South Kordofan state.\nUNMAS undertakes survey and clearance activities to identify the areas and major routes leading to and from the targeted communities with explosive hazards contamination and will accordingly remove any explosive threats that are found. Once areas and routes are declared free from explosive hazards, other UN organisations and community-based NGOs, CBOs, CSOs provide life-saving water, sanitation and hygiene, health, and food security and livelihood interventions that are planned and coordinated with the local communities to create synergies and comprehensive outcomes. \n
